notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content:
Bug Fix
在我孩子玩这个游戏是发现一些BUG，现已修复
When my boy is playing this game.I found some problems, and now they are fixed

1.修正退出小游戏时记分未清，导致速度统计错误的BUG
Fixed:Speed Value was wrong 

2.修正飞机BOSS RUSH时胜利后之前的游戏时间不会被保存 
Fixed:Aircraft boss rush time not be recorded in Log list 

3.修正FV-189飞机命中字母时不扣血的BUG
Fixed:FV-189 HP can not be hurted by hitting characters.

4.Remove DRM

notes.title: Officially launched today
notes.content:
Update today:
1. A comprehensive upgrade of "Tank War". Learning and re-painting the surface material, the overall game effect has been greatly improved.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34917649/c3c9d94c5b59e6f9a29c6f7927463ef956e583f9.png[/img]
2. The "Tank War" AI is upgraded to avoid the original chance of being stuck on the hillside, and the bug that cannot be attacked due to the hillside occlusion.
3. Add some sound effects of the tank game, and modify the sound effect in the setting interface by the sound effect control, the original part of the sound effect is controlled by the music volume.
4. Fix some basic archive read bugs.
5. After the aircraft game is cut back from the tank game, the camera flies off the BUG repair.
6. F1 mode menu function removal
7. The aircraft settings interface returns to the archive save settings
8. Various interface optimizations, ESC interface buttons beautify, remove unnecessary floating prompts, etc.
9. Image replacement in the tutorial
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34917649/162b054dbd943aae738e7cf92f1fec918e43f1eb.png[/img]
10. Steam shop videos and screenshots update!

As the update is constantly being updated, the actual effect is subject to the actual game!
